author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Here on Lulu Island, a few days ago, I've tried the Jerk-spiced Chicken Rice Bowl from Subway, but I've yet to try the expensive Hawaiian goodies at Steve's Poké Bar. This morning, the 25th of November of 2024, after 6, still dark as night, I saw Michael J. the Dane-French, whilst I was walking. He showed me new pictures on his cellphone about strange neighbourhood lights that he attributes to extraterrestrials. I mention to him about Elon Musk's apparent position on the matter that aliens haven't visited us here on Earth, but he doesn't discount the mathematical probability that life, intelligent or not, exists on faraway worlds. He's mentioned that there may be many one-planet civilizations that may have died out. He thinks that it is important that our Terran consciousness would be propagated outside of Earth for our own security. It's important that we have a "multiplanetary" civilization, Elon opines. We don't want to be a one-planet civilization that just dies out. I told Michael my two reasons that aliens would hide from us: (1) They're higher beings that have compassion for lower beings like us Earthlings, and (2) we as Terrans and Earth as a whole could be their EXPERIMENT, so they don't want to disturb it. Later, walking, I reached Starbucks café. I drank an Iced Gingerbread Oat Chai, then a reddish Passion Tango iced tea, from my barista Emma, an Iranian. At my corner window table, I was reading the Esperanto sci-fi book La Imperio Ornaks.

text: 呢度露露島，幾日前，我試過地鐵嘅 Jerk 香料雞飯碗，但係我仲未試過 Steve 嘅 Poké Bar 貴價嘅夏威夷好物。今朝，即係2024年11月25號，六點幾，仲係夜晚咁黑，我喺行緊嘅時候見到丹麥法國人 Michael J. 。佢喺佢部手機度畀我睇咗啲關於奇怪嘅街坊燈光嘅新相，佢將呢啲燈光歸因於外星生物。我同佢提過 Elon Musk 對於外星人喺呢度地球上未探訪過我哋呢件事嘅明顯立場，但佢冇折扣過生命，無論係智能定唔係，都存在喺遠方世界嘅數學概率。佢提到可能有好多一個星球嘅文明可能已經死咗。佢覺得為咗我哋自己嘅安全，我哋嘅地球人意識會喺地球以外傳播係好重要。 Elon 認為，我哋有一個「多行星」文明係好重要。我哋唔想成為一個一粒粒星球嘅文明，然後就咁消失。我同 Michael 講咗我兩個外星人會隱瞞我哋嘅原因：（1）佢哋係高等生物，對我哋地球人呢啲低等生物有同情心，同埋（2）我哋作為地球人同整個地球可能係佢哋嘅實驗，所以佢哋唔想打擾到佢。後來，行路，我去到星巴克咖啡館。我飲咗一杯冰薑餅燕麥茶，然後係一杯紅色嘅 Passion Tango 冰茶，係由我嘅咖啡師 Emma 飲嘅，佢係一個伊朗人。喺我個角落窗枱度，我睇緊世界語科幻書《帝國奧納克斯》。
